title: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS high tensile polished Road Train Aluminium Bullbar. #9
description: Kenworth T610 SAR FUPS high tensile polished aluminium Bullbar. Three main, one piece 76mm cross tubes through drilled uprights and recessed into drilled outer uprights (optional 88 or 100mm tubes on request). 100mm box uprights shown with outer uprights set flush with main channel. Driving light mounts to suit application. Heavy duty backing plate with 38mm tow pin, Optional hi-tensile aluminium backing plate available on request giving up to an 80kg saving over the steel backing plate. Reversible Road Train / Long Vehicle signs with polished aluminium covers plus Dangerous Goods book on aluminium mounting plate. Driving light mounts to customer spec. Front mudflap mounts on rear of main channel. Bull bar can be custom built to your specifications.
